desc: Explore approaches; select suffix-DP state machine (position, last letter, run length capped at 1/2/3+) plus greedy lexicographic reconstruction, O(26n).
Implement suffix DP F1/F3 (F2 folded into F1) with base F3[n][c]=0, F1[n][c]=INF, using two-smallest trick for min over d!=c in O(26) per i.
Store F1 and F3 in memory-efficient flat array('i') for reconstruction queries.

Implement greedy reconstruction: smallest initial run letter, force current letter while runlen<3, and at runlen>=3 pick smallest d with |x_i-d| + (F3[i+1][d] if d==cur else F1[i+1][d]) == F3[i][cur].

Verify against the 3 provided examples ("cdcd"->"cccc", "aca"->"aaa", "bc"->"") and brute-force enumeration over small alphabets/lengths; confirmed minimum cost, lexicographic tie-break, and edge cases.
